cards.imageAlt: 客舱撤离训练，用于本话题的看图描述和问答
cards.taskTitle: 客舱撤离训练 · 看图材料

cards.audioText: Please describe the picture in detail.
cards.referenceText: They are practicing emergency evacuation. A man is just sliding down a slider. Another man is dressed very formally. He is standing beside the slide and he seems to be the instructor. There is another man standing at the door. I can just see his legs and he seems to be ready to jump onto the slide.
cards.referenceTextZh: 他们正在练习紧急疏散。一个男人从滑梯上滑下。另一个穿着非常正式的男人站在滑梯旁边，看起来像是教员。还有另一个人站在舱门口，我只能看到他的腿，似乎是准备跳到滑梯上。

cards.audioText: How many slides are there on the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞的飞机上有多少滑梯？
cards.referenceText: I fly cargo aircraft, Boeing 747-400. There is only one slide on our aircraft. / I fly passenger aircraft, Boeing 747-400. There are 12 slides on our aircraft, including two slides on upper deck and ten on lower deck.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞货机，波音747-400。机上只有一个滑梯。/我飞客机，波音747-400全客飞机有12个滑梯，上舱2个，下舱10个，Combi飞机有10个滑梯，上舱2个，下舱8个。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me a little bit about the location of the slides on an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 能稍微讲讲机上滑梯的位置么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. It is located in the emergency exit on the upper deck.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。滑梯在上舱的紧急出门处。

cards.audioText: What can slides be used for?
cards.referenceText: It is normally used for evacuate passengers when abnormal situation happens, and some slides are also designed to serve as rafts in the event of a landing on water.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发生异常情况时，滑梯通常用于疏散乘客。有时候飞机降落在水上，有些滑梯可以当救生筏使用。

cards.audioText: Have you ever met any emergency evacuation? Tell me something about that.
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到过紧急救援么？讲一讲。
cards.referenceText: Yes, once we took off from Wuhan, the fan cowl doors on both engines detached, and it caused severe damage including a punctured right engine fuel pipe. During returning, an external fire developed on that engine which was shut down. After landing, an emergency evacuation of the occupants was achieved without injury and the engine fire was extinguished.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过，有一次飞机从武汉起飞，发动机上的风扇罩门全部脱落，造成了严重的损害，包括右侧发动机燃油管被刺穿。返回时，关闭的发动机外部起火。降落后，机舱内人员全部被营救出来，没有人受伤，发动机外部的火也被扑灭了。

cards.audioText: What are the duties of flight crew in an emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急疏散中，机组人员的职责是什么？
cards.referenceText: Evacuation is normally ordered by the captain. However, if communication with the flight crew is not possible and the situation in the cabin is judged by the senior cabin crew member to be incompatible with any delay, then the cabin crew themselves make the evacuation order once the aircraft has come to a complete stop. Normally, the captain will be the last to leave the aircraft. Once they are out of the aircraft, they assist in moving passengers away from the aircraft to a position where they can be safely grouped together.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常是机长下令进行疏散。然而，如果机长无法联系到机组人员，且客舱内高级机组成员判定不能有任何延误，那么飞机完全停下后机组人员就可以立刻组织疏散。通常机长是最后一个离开飞机的。一旦他们下了飞机，就要帮助乘客一起转移到远离飞机的安全位置。

cards.audioText: What are the main differences between ditching and force landings on ground? What should cabin crew prepare for ditching?
cards.audioTextZh: 水面迫降和陆地迫降有什么区别？机组人员应如何应对水上迫降？
cards.referenceText: Ditching especially refers to the force landing on water. It is one of the force landings. If problem happens when the flight is flying over the ocean or lake, the flight attendants must notify the passengers at first, and then brief them the items they should pay attention to, such as the passengers should put off their shoes, especially high heel shoes, they should wear off their glasses, earrings and other sharp particles in case of being hurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 水面迫降指飞机被迫降落在水面上，是迫降方式的一种。飞机在海洋或湖泊等水面上飞行时，如果遇到问题机组成员必须第一时间通知乘客，并简要告知其注意事项，如乘客应该脱掉鞋子，尤其是高跟鞋；乘客应该摘掉眼镜、耳环等尖锐物品，以防受伤。

cards.audioText: What do you do in the emergency training every year?
cards.audioTextZh: 在一年一次的紧急训练中，你都做些什么？
cards.referenceText: The emergency training includes studying emergency knowledge in ground school and emergency drills in the Cabin Service Trainer. I learn the detailed procedure of emergency situation and practice emergency evacuation in our simulator training center.
cards.referenceTextZh: 紧急训练包括在地面训练学校学习紧急救援知识和在客舱服务训练部进行紧急演习。我学习了应对紧急情况的具体操作程序，并在模拟机训练中心练习了紧急救援。
